body.statement: Under i.i.d. sampling, finite second moments, \(p^\star\ge\kappa>0\), and positive definite \(\Omega\), \(\sqrt n(\widehat{\boldsymbol\theta}-\boldsymbol\theta)=n^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^n\phi_{\theta}(O_i)+o_P(1)\Rightarrow N(0,\Omega)\). The plug-in \(\widehat\Omega\) is consistent and \(P(\boldsymbol\theta\in\mathcal C_{\theta})\to1-\alpha_0\).
body.justification: All effects share signed cell moments and denominators, so joint covariance propagation is necessary for simultaneous claims.
body.gap: Blackwell--Pashley provide the scalar and vector factorial-IV ingredients; this theorem records their adaptation to the Möbius vector and is an inference rung rather than the novelty kernel.
body.consumer: The result permits family-wise statements about all seven factorial effects in software and applied reanalysis when the perfect-complier share is not weak.
